name: Basteyur
source:
A devil with the rank of Baron. Among demons, titles are proportional to power and ability, so he stands out from other demons. His fighting power is incomparable to that of any demon, and even the Demon King cannot lay a hand on him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char07.html]Mink[/url]]
